summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing Phase 2a study results for Namodenoson in pancreatic cancer. The study met its primary safety endpoint and showed durable survival in advanced disease. The registrant is the issuer reporting clinical trial outcomes; no merger, acquisition, or special-situation transaction is involved. This is a routine disclosure of clinical development progress, not a special situation event. No deal terms are present.
